title: Fisherman sees an orb explode off Ubatuba and collects fragments
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Fisherman sees an orb explode off Ubatuba and collects fragments, about 1957 at Ubatuba, Brazil, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: One of the most interesting samples Nolan mentions is from Uba Tuba, Brazil, where [music] a fisherman witnessed an exploding orb off the coast and collected some of the parts.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, retells a case raised by Garry Nolan, a Stanford scientist who studies material said to come from unexplained objects. According to Michels, a fisherman near Ubatuba, on the coast of Brazil, saw a glowing ball explode over the sea and gathered up some of the pieces that fell. Michels calls it one of Nolan's most interesting samples, because if the story holds, it would be physical debris from something unexplained.
